deaths.summary: An SUV hit a pedestrian, throwing him into a Waymo coming the other way. He died after being taken to hospital.
deaths.note: Dallas police described the SUV as the first vehicle to strike him. The empty Waymo was also involved; this source does not establish that the AV caused the death.

sources.label: FOX4 Dallas-Fort Worth: Dallas pedestrian dies after being struck by SUV, thrown into Waymo

injuries.summary: A sedan and a Waymo collided on Venice Boulevard. Fire officials reported two people hospitalized and another treated at the scene.
injuries.note: Waymo says the other car struck a pedestrian before entering the opposite lane and hitting its vehicle. Police said their investigation was ongoing. NBC4 reported three injuries, while ABC7 reported five. This entry counts at least three. News reports describe an autonomous Waymo; driving mode at impact is not independently confirmed in the reviewed federal records.

injuries.note: Firefighters described the Jeep striking the Waymo from behind. Waymo says its vehicle was making a left turn; no final fault finding was located. The two specifically described injuries were in the Jeep. The Waymo was reported to be unoccupied.

animals.summary: Waymo reported striking a raccoon that ran into its lane in Del Valle. Vehicle damage and towing were reported; the raccoon’s outcome was not stated.
Avride reported that its vehicle approached a duck lying in the road and made contact with it while proceeding straight. The collision killed the duck.
Waymo reported striking a domestic animal that ran into its lane in Los Angeles. The animal sustained injuries.
Waymo reported striking a deer that ran into its lane in Burlingame. Vehicle damage and towing were reported; the deer’s outcome was not stated.
Waymo reported that a dog entered the road between parked cars and was struck while the vehicle slowed and moved left. The dog sustained injuries.
